input.reason: The claim specifies a flow completion time of 12 ms under "fixed configuration A," but the actual parameters of configuration A are not supplied anywhere in the context. The previous critic feedback identified two concrete design issues: (1) the direction of added delay is unspecified, and (2) there is no defined replication unit. To resolve these without inventing inputs: we need the exact specification of "configuration A" (topology, link delays with direction, bandwidth, queue sizes, flow size, protocol, etc.), the precise delay injection direction, and a justified replication/sampling design. None of these are available in the supplied materials. The source is explicitly described as a synthetic evaluation packet with no real paper reviewed, so there is no source text from which to extract the missing parameters. Without these inputs, no executable proposal can be constructed.

blockers.detail: 'Configuration A' is referenced but never defined. The exact network topology, link parameters (bandwidth, base RTT, queue size), flow size, transport protocol, and all other fixed settings are required to reproduce the claimed 12 ms completion time.
blockers.required_input: Complete specification of configuration A including all link/node parameters, flow size, and protocol.

blockers.detail: The critic identified that the direction of added delay (e.g., forward path, reverse path, or both) is unspecified. This is essential for any netem-based emulation and cannot be guessed.
blockers.required_input: Explicit specification of which link(s) and direction(s) delay is applied to in configuration A.

blockers.detail: The critic identified the absence of a replication unit. A valid experimental design requires defining what constitutes an independent replicate (e.g., separate flow on a freshly reset emulated link) and justifying the independence assumption, before a sample size or statistical method can be chosen.
blockers.required_input: Definition of the replication unit, justification of independence between replicates, and the intended number of replicates with rationale.
